checkpoint: one domain rendering end to end, read back out of a real browser, plus the finding that came out of doing it
cp2Subject: fleet-vehicles on the Fleet lens, end to end: the registered domain, the served route, the shipped renderer, and the text a person actually reads.

fourStatesReadBackOffThePixel.note: all five determinations were driven through the SHIPPED renderer. ungranted and granted-empty are unreachable on any shipped pack for these domains, so the payloads were produced by the REAL seam (composeDomain against a pack missing the grant, and against a domain whose generate returns []) and served through a Playwright route interception. Nothing about the renderer was stubbed and no payload was hand-written; harness P:/tmp/r3-work/mk-payloads.mjs.

ok.head: The Vehicle roster region is generating records on template-city.
ok.basis: Basis: generated from the Samsara adapter output contract; no city rows were read

fourStatesReadBackOffThePixel.theClaimThisSettles: ungranted and granted-empty differ in kicker, in head and in basis. Ruling 1 is now visible to a customer rather than implemented in a seam nobody can see.

findingRaisedAtCP2.what: the light-theme p-ok pill fails color contrast
findingRaisedAtCP2.measured: --sc-ok #2F7A52 on --sc-ok-wash #E3F0E8 = 4.44:1, computed from the shipped token values. The pill sets 12px/500 text, so the requirement is 4.5:1. It is 0.06 short.
findingRaisedAtCP2.everyOtherPair: light p-info 4.97, p-warn 4.74, p-crit 5.52, p-restricted 5.97, p-quiet 5.07; dark p-ok 6.14, p-info 5.51, p-warn 6.16, p-crit 5.34, p-quiet 4.74, p-restricted 5.31. All pass. p-ok in light is the only failing pair.
findingRaisedAtCP2.howItSurfaced: axe on lens-fleet in the LIGHT theme reported color-contrast 6 nodes, sampled at the In service pills in the roster table. The dark theme is clean. This lane is the first surface to render eight ok-severity pills.
findingRaisedAtCP2.whereItLives: web/sc-kit.css, which its own header says is byte-identical across smartcity-dashboards, smart-files and plan-review, and which a Dashboards PR may not edit without forking the product line. Same class of finding as G-94, which fixed --sc-ink-3 and --sc-quiet and did not exercise this pair.
findingRaisedAtCP2.openReconciliation: Development services ALSO renders p-ok - the pipeline generates 2 ready-to-issue records, severity ok - and the light-theme baseline scan of lens-development-services reported NO color-contrast. Two numbers that should agree and do not. Working hypothesis, untested: axe put those two nodes in the incomplete bucket rather than violations, the elmPartiallyObscuring class G-95 already hit, which would also explain why 6 of my 8 pills were reported rather than 8. NOT settled, and named as open rather than rounded off (DEV_PROCESS 1.4). If it resolves the other way, the wave-3 light-theme baseline undercounted and that is the a11y lane's to know.
findingRaisedAtCP2.whatThisLaneDid: rendered a RESOLVED status quiet rather than green, on the visual law's own ground - quiet surfaces, loud exceptions, applicability inverted so a pass is quiet. The resolved flag has sat on every status vocabulary since G-77 and no renderer had read it. The contrast measurement is stated at the decision, in the code comment and in the test, so the reason cannot later be mistaken for the other one.
findingRaisedAtCP2.whatThisLaneDidNotDo: touch sc-kit.css, or pretend the token pair is fine. The test computes the ratio live and FAILS once the kit is fixed, which forces the carrier decision to be re-taken in the open instead of quietly outliving its reason.
findingRaisedAtCP2.carriedToPlanner: yes - a cross-repo token fix in the G-94 shape, plus a product-line call on whether Development services should also render resolved statuses quiet. One severity vocabulary currently has two renderings across two lenses, and that is a real cost of this decision rather than a free win.

The assertion was wrong, not the markup - the exclusion is deliberately NAMED on the surface - so it was rewritten to test what is COLUMNED and what the renderer READS. Recorded because a gate that fires on its own copy would have been quietly loosened instead.

measuredAtCP2.flake: one npm test invocation on the loaded machine failed with UND_ERR_SOCKET 'other side closed' inside the server suite; the immediately following invocation was 336/336 green. Five concurrent scripts/a11y-scan.mjs processes from the G-95 lane and three src/server.mjs processes were live on this machine at the time. Reported rather than suppressed; CI is authoritative.

environmentContention.observed: five G-95 browser plants plus three servers running concurrently on this machine. A curl of index.html took 10.0s at the worst point and seven of sixteen axe targets timed out on a 45s navigation budget.
environmentContention.consequence: the after-scan is re-run rather than reported from a partial pass. The dark after-scan completed 15 of 16 (work-people timed out; that surface is unchanged by this lane and its 1 heading-order node reconciles the 11 -> 8 + 1 arithmetic exactly).
environmentContention.handling: no other lane's process was touched. Nothing was killed.

CP2: Q: is the ungranted evidence real, or a payload I wrote to look right? A: it is composeDomain's output against a pack missing the grant, generated by the shipped seam and written to disk before the browser ran. The head sentence is composed by the shipped renderer from that payload. What is stubbed is the transport and nothing else.

Q: does the quiet carrier hide the kit defect? A: it would if the measurement were not carried. It is carried three times - in the code comment at the decision, in a test that fails when the kit is fixed, and in this checkpoint with the hex pair and the ratio - and the divergence it creates against Development services is named as a cost rather than omitted.

Q: could the four states still collapse later? A: the kicker set is asserted to have five distinct members and the two absence heads are asserted to differ, and both arms were watched firing. That is the strongest guard available without a browser in CI.

Q: what is still unproven at CP2? A: the full both-theme after-scan (contention), the CI conclusion string, and the DS reconciliation in the finding above. All three are close deliverables, not assumptions.
